agents.role: Runs the route board: which sections are serviced, what is outstanding, and which routes run late against the window.
Watches truck health across the fleet so a truck that goes down mid-route is known in the yard and on the dispatch board, not discovered by a stranded crew.
Keeps the storm operations record and the collection record as it happens, and seals each at shift end.
The only agent in this pack that may post across worlds. Publishes storm clearing status by sector as counts, and receives road closure and service diversion summaries.

alerts.carries: The route or section id and the minutes past the service window. Local to the depot; the dispatcher acts on it.
The truck id, the fault class, and the affected route id. Local only.
The truck id, the route id, and the last crew check-in time. Local only; crews are never named on any bus line.
The sector id and the estimated spreader passes of salt remaining, marked as an estimate.
The worker id (local only), the hours on shift, and the flag reason. Local to the depot.
A summary only: sector ids, plow pass counts, and service state per sector (serviced, partial, missed as counts). No crew names, no truck details.

receives.carries: Road closures and perimeter state affecting plow routes, summarized; no police record details.
Transit reroutes and diversions that change collection schedules or gate access, as states and counts.

sends.carries: Storm clearing status by sector: pass counts and service state per sector. Counts and states only.
Storm clearing status by sector: pass counts and service state per sector. Counts and states only.

firstboot.label: Borough or sector this depot serves
Route roster: routes and the crews riding them
Storm plow pass interval in minutes

bus_summary: Sector plow and spreader pass counts during storm operations
Service state by sector as counts (serviced, partial, missed)
Storm status summaries for mutual aid and interoperability
local_only: Worker names, crew assignments, and time entries
Truck fault codes, locations, and spreader rate logs
Individual complaint and missed-collection details before review
The full collection and storm records before they are sealed

summary: Sanitation operations pack: watches collection route completion, truck health, storm plow and spreader operations, and keeps the sealed collection and storm records. Built around depot crews and their shifts: late routes, trucks down mid-route, stranded crews, salt estimates, and hours-on-shift flags for the union crew. Storm status crosses to other worlds as counts only. SPEC ONLY: this is a pack definition, not a running sanitation system.

urgency.meaning: A crew unreachable or stranded during storm operations. Preempts everything else on the bus.
Routes past their window, trucks down mid-route, low salt estimates, and live storm status.
Hours-on-shift flags and roster state changes.
Sealed collection record and end-of-shift storm summary.

inputs: crew check-ins at section start and end
watchers.watches: Collection route state: which sections are serviced, which are partial or missed, and which routes run late against the service window for the depot.

inputs: onboard fault codes read in the yard
watchers.watches: Truck health: fault codes, fuel and spreader attachment state, and which trucks are out of service, so a truck that dies mid-route is known before the crew is stranded.
Snow operations: plow and spreader assignment per gate and section, pass counts against the plow interval, spreader rates, and worker hours on shift.
The verified operations record: sections serviced and missed per route per day, storm passes per sector, sealed at shift end.
